file.refused: the AI declined to read this file. Check that it's a bank statement or transaction export
file.unusable: the AI's answer couldn't be turned into transactions
file.pdfUnsupported: the selected AI provider can't read PDFs. Switch to Anthropic or OpenAI, or import a CSV export
file.noVision: the selected model can't read images. Pick a vision model in Settings
